mapAuto: No custom layout: the maze is generated randomly at each load. Generate one here to touch it up by hand.
mapCustom: Custom layout in use: this one is always displayed.
mapPoster: "Poster" cells are walls where posters are pasted; a "portal" can be walked through and teleports to another portal.
generate: Generate a random layout to edit
generateAgain: Replace with a new random layout
generated: Layout generated: edit it, then save.
errNoPath: At least one walkable "path" cell is required.
lblHint: Pick a brush, then click or drag over the cells.
